(
    `x` Int32,

        SELECT x
        WHERE x > 0
        ORDER BY x
    )
)
ENGINE = MergeTree

SELECT x LIKE 'a!_%' ESCAPE '!'
FROM t

SELECT (j['key1'])['key2']

FROM t

(
    SELECT *
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            y,
            count() AS c
        FROM
        (
            SELECT *
            FROM
            (
                SELECT *
                FROM t
            )
            WHERE x > 1
        )
        GROUP BY y
    )
    ORDER BY c DESC
)
LIMIT 10
